_methodology.description: GeoSamanvay adversarial benchmark -- 7 realistic error categories
_methodology.note: Controlled synthetic stress test. Each category injects N cases with known ground truth and measures whether GeoSamanvay detection engines correctly flag them. Background (clean) cases measure FP rate.

categories.name: CRS_SHIFT
categories.description: Projected-metre coords mislabelled as WGS84 degrees
categories.detection_method: Pre-ingest coord range check: |x|>1000 or |y|>90 -> rejected

categories.name: ROTATION
categories.description: Boundary rotation 5-30 deg from scan digitisation
categories.detection_method: Geometry compare: IoU drop + Hausdorff offset

categories.name: OVERLAP
categories.description: Same parcel: municipal boundary 10-20% larger than cadastral
categories.detection_method: Geometry compare: AREA_MISMATCH + BOUNDARY_OFFSET on same-parcel pair

categories.name: GAP
categories.description: Same parcel: source B shifted 5-15m (datum / survey offset)
categories.detection_method: Geometry compare: BOUNDARY_OFFSET on same-parcel source pair

categories.name: ATTRIBUTE_CONFLICT
categories.description: Owner name / land-use disagreement between sources

categories.name: TEMPORAL_CHANGE
categories.description: Genuine boundary change detected across 2+ year gap
categories.detection_method: Change detection: is_temporal=True when gap > 180 days

categories.name: SHARED_ORIGIN
categories.description: 3 datasets from same 1999 survey -- should report 1 independent lineage
categories.detection_method: Provenance DAG DFS: count distinct root origin nodes
